MEASURED live 22:55Z: one line read '1,610.0 practical mi × $0.60/mi · $958.69' — 1,610 × 0.60 = 966.00 ≠ 958.69. ROOT CAUSE: the prior tab (and the driver-bills.routes.ts it read from) surfaced driver_bills.rate_per_mile_cents directly as if it produced gross_amount_cents — the SAME SET-RATE class of defect (a stored rate column that can be blended/wrong, filed to CC-2, independent of the amount it actually produced), plus it combined loaded+deadhead into one 'practical' mileage figure instead of two separated lines. FIX: new GET /api/v1/driver-finance/loads/:loadId/driver-pay-detail (driver-bills.routes.ts) derives every mileage line's rate as amount_cents/miles ON THE SAME ROW — impossible-by-construction, not merely asserted — reading miles_basis (loaded) and miles_deadhead (empty) SEPARATELY; rewritten apps/frontend/src/components/dispatch/LoadDetailDriverPayTab.tsx consumes it with two mileage lines, accessorial/deduction/broker-advance cards, and a posting-preview card (driver_pay_expense/ap_control, via resolveRoleAccountOptional — no new GL math), all on the .ldt-* token palette (no hex literals). Live-verified: 48 USMCA driver_bills, 0 mismatches (>1 cent), posting-preview accounts resolve. Number 8060 is pre-claimed by the 'cursor' lane for this exact purpose (scripts/verify-steps/CLAIMED-NUMBERS.json) — CC-3 has no verify-step lane and is unmapped/fails-closed on any new numbered file, so this guard ships as a plain unnumbered file per the same CC-3 lane-band constraint as verify-drv03-server-side-dqf-hard-block-gate.mjs above; runs via verify-static.mjs's own scripts/verify-*.mjs glob auto-discovery plus its own --selftest; wire into 8060 once the cursor lane's claim authors it, or a different number once CC-3 has a lane.
